timeline.text: Welcome to Comparing Yourself to Everyone Else. I will guide you through each tapping point. At every point, you will hear a short phrase. Repeat it aloud, or quietly inside your head. Let us begin.

timeline.ins: Begin tapping on the side of your hand.
timeline.say: I keep comparing myself to everyone else.

timeline.ins: Now tap the top of your head.
timeline.say: Their progress makes me feel behind.

timeline.ins: Move to the beginning of your eyebrows.
timeline.say: I am focusing on everything they have that I do not.

timeline.ins: Now tap at the side of your eyes.
timeline.say: My mind is turning their life into a measure of mine.

timeline.ins: Move under your eyes.
timeline.say: I can feel this inadequacy in my body.

timeline.ins: Now tap under your nose.
timeline.say: Part of me believes I should be further along.

timeline.ins: Move to your chin.
timeline.say: I am overlooking how much I have carried.

timeline.ins: Now tap your collarbones.
timeline.say: I can admit that comparison is hurting me.

timeline.ins: Finish this round under your arm.
timeline.say: It feels like everyone else is moving faster.

timeline.text: Take one easy breath. Notice whether anything has shifted, even slightly. If nothing has changed yet, that is completely okay. Keep breathing, and we will continue.

timeline.ins: Return to the side of your hand.
timeline.say: I can notice comparison without following it.

timeline.ins: Tap the top of your head.
timeline.say: I am seeing a snapshot, not a whole life.

timeline.ins: Move to the beginning of your eyebrows.
timeline.say: Someone else’s progress does not erase mine.

timeline.ins: Tap at the side of your eyes.
timeline.say: My path is allowed to have a different rhythm.

timeline.ins: Move under your eyes.
timeline.say: My body can soften around the feeling of being behind.

timeline.ins: Tap under your nose.
timeline.say: I can remember what matters to me.

timeline.ins: Move to your chin.
timeline.say: I do not need to turn inspiration into punishment.

timeline.ins: Tap your collarbones.
timeline.say: I can acknowledge the progress I have made.

timeline.ins: Finish this round under your arm.
timeline.say: I can return to my own direction.

timeline.text: Take another slow breath. Notice what feels different now. You do not need the feeling to disappear. See if there is simply a little less pressure, or a little more choice in how you meet this moment.

timeline.ins: Return to the side of your hand.
timeline.say: I am allowed to move at my pace.

timeline.ins: Tap the top of your head.
timeline.say: My life is not a race against someone else.

timeline.ins: Move to the beginning of your eyebrows.
timeline.say: I can celebrate others without abandoning myself.

timeline.ins: Tap at the side of your eyes.
timeline.say: I choose goals that belong to me.

timeline.ins: Move under your eyes.
timeline.say: My body can feel at home on my path.

timeline.ins: Tap under your nose.
timeline.say: I trust the progress that is not always visible.

timeline.ins: Move to your chin.
timeline.say: I am worthy in the middle of becoming.

timeline.ins: Tap your collarbones.
timeline.say: I can take one step in my own direction.

timeline.ins: Finish under your arm.
timeline.say: My attention is coming back to my life.

timeline.text: Let your hands rest, and take one full breath. Notice how you feel now, without needing to judge it. Thank you for taking this time for yourself. Carry this steadiness with you as you continue.
